verdict.rationale: Abacum's first-party pages say it connects ERP and accounting systems and builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow off live ERP actuals that 'flow in' without copy-paste. A community commenter also describes integration toggles and a data-mapping menu. However, none of the evidence names QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite, and the same commenter questioned how much data onboarding is self-service. Missing for 10: confirmation of specific QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connectors, evidence of founder-level self-serve setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated actuals sync.
